Operationalization plan for [[conventions.seedDensity]]. Three layers in cost order — convention before infrastructure; don't build a later layer before the earlier one proves out.

L1 (DONE 2026-04-09): principle saved as conventions.seedDensity + CLAUDE.md updated; agents write with the activation-per-byte lens.
L2 (file as issues once L1 has shaped real entry-writing): rvr lint --seed-quality — heuristic low-amplification detection on the arch.lint infra; rvr topology — co-occurrence analysis over audit.jsonl (which entries travel together in sessions; killer dogfooding screenshot).
L3 (north stars; lens = "does it help users write seeds that activate denser biomes, or just add storage capacity?"): telemetry-driven tier promotion in reverie_context, seed-pack templates for rvr init, optional meta.testedWith, rvr explain <entry>.

DON'T: measure LLM activation directly; make seed-density a hard requirement — it's a lens, not a rule.
